data.text: Claim response now re-reads the journal after the write (field claim: claimed | already_yours | contested). Cost: claim ~121 ms median at 400 events vs ~105 ms for a read; at 10k events the re-read pays the cold path B4 describes until KAD-45 lands. Agents without KADENCE_ACTOR pay one git spawn (~10 ms) in ready/prime/claim to detect a linked worktree. A same-checkout race still has a microsecond window between ulid() and append.
